releases.name: AnyPS5 Studio v1.5.1
releases.body:
AnyPS5 Studio 1.5.1 updates the bundled AnyPS5 core from v0.1.2 to **[v0.1.4](https://github.com/boykopovar/AnyPS5/releases/tag/v0.1.4)**.

## Changes
- **AnyPS5 core v0.1.4**: the bundled relinker and system libraries now come from the latest upstream release. Existing installs switch to it automatically the next time Studio starts, and each game receives the new libraries on its next launch.
- **Relink hint**: Studio now remembers which core relinked each game. If a game was relinked with an earlier core, the launch log says so and suggests relinking it in Relinker Studio if it fails to start.
- **Verified core downloads**: the bundled core is checked against the SHA-256 checksums AnyPS5 publishes for the release; a mismatch stops the build.
- The NID inspector's "Python 3 not found" message now points to the correct re-audit button.

## After updating
If a game that worked before no longer starts, open **Relinker Studio** and relink it.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ramsforge/AnyPS5-Studio/compare/v1.5.0...v1.5.1

releases.name: AnyPS5 Studio v1.5.0
releases.body:
AnyPS5 Studio 1.5.0 is the biggest update so far: full controller support, playtime tracking, safer handling of your game folders, a faster app that works offline, and a round of security hardening.

## Highlights

### Full controller navigation
- Use the D-pad / left stick to move around every screen (menus, Settings, dialogs, setup and the launcher). Cross selects, Circle goes back, L1 / R1 switch tabs.
- On the game row, Left / Right still pick a game and Cross plays it; press Down to reach the game's buttons.
- Studio ignores the controller while you are playing a game, so button presses never reach Studio behind it.
- Controller rumble now follows the Haptic Feedback setting.
- Arrow keys and Escape work the same way on the keyboard.

### Playtime tracking
- Total playtime and your last session are recorded for every game and shown on the home screen.

### Safer game folders
- Studio only reorganizes folders that actually contain a PS5 title, and no longer moves game assets just because their name looks like a backup (for example `*.baked`).

releases.name: X360 Mobile 0.6.6
releases.body:
# X360 Mobile 0.6.6

- Integrated Xenia Edge upstream through November 20, 2026. This brings updates across CPU and system emulation, graphics, audio and game content handling while preserving X360 Mobile's Android features and existing fixes.
- Improved handling of game updates and Android storage access. Updated the in-game interface and input handling.
- Continued work on reducing shader-related pauses at the beginning of **Fable II**. New scenes can still pause while shaders are prepared.

Focused checks on Odin 2 covered gameplay in **GTA IV**, **Forza Horizon 2** and **Fable II**, as well as pause, resume and shutdown in **Assassin's Creed**. Results can vary across titles, devices and drivers.

TV mode, synced player profiles and picture-in-picture remain experimental. You can install this release over your current version.

releases.name: X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 8
releases.body:
# X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 8

This update improves graphics accuracy and adds better diagnostic information for investigating driver performance reports.

## General graphics correction

- Corrected a graphics accuracy issue observed as temporary black, blue or multicoloured corruption during the opening of **Fable II**.
- The correction applies automatically and may also help other games affected by similar rendering problems. No additional game setting is required for this correction; existing recommended settings remain available.
- Verified through two opening runs reaching the first childhood gameplay scene on Odin 2. Later scenes, full campaigns and other GPUs still need testing.
- This is an accuracy improvement, with no general FPS increase promised. Brief pauses may still occur when new shaders are prepared.

## Driver diagnostics and session sharing

- Added more useful texture and performance information for investigating reported slowdowns with **RADV on Exynos/Xclipse**.
- Gameplay measurement recordings are now associated with their session and can be included when using **Share session bundle** from Session history.

releases.name: X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 7
releases.body:
# X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 7

This update brings a general graphics correctness improvement and experimental picture-in-picture support for external media apps.

## Graphics correction

- Fixed the horizontally divided image and missing lower portion observed in the opening real-time cutscene of **Kingdoms of Amalur: Reckoning**.
- This is a general core correction, applied automatically without additional settings. It may benefit other games affected by similar rendering problems, but wider game and GPU coverage still needs testing.
- Verified through repeated starts and progression to character creation on Odin 2. This does not certify the full campaign or promise a general FPS increase.

## Experimental picture-in-picture

- Keep the game full screen while a compatible external media app uses Android's floating video window.
- Added an app selector with PiP compatibility indicators, an optional media link, and controls in the game menu. Find these options under **Settings → App → Appearance and startup**.

releases.name: X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 6
releases.body:
# X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 6

Maintenance update focused on optional driver compatibility and updated game recommendations.

- Added an optional experimental texture compatibility setting for RADV on Samsung Xclipse. It is disabled by default and has not yet been verified on Xclipse hardware. Successful driver loading, rendering and performance are not guaranteed; memory use may increase.
- Added recommended settings for **Mobile Suit Gundam: Operation Troy**, restoring the visible world in the first map tested on Odin 2. A complete game copy is required; other devices and the full campaign remain unverified.
- Added recommendations for **Sonic Free Riders with the adapted No Kinect mod**. The compatible adapted mod and its designated launcher are required: settings alone do not repair the original mod, and the mod is not bundled with the app. Menus and two tutorial stages were tested; uneven steering remains under investigation, and full-game compatibility is not confirmed.

releases.name: X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 5
releases.body:
# X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 5

Maintenance update focused on game loading reliability and clearer driver diagnostics.

- Improved handling of extracted games, disc images and installed game containers.
- Added a per-game startup executable selector for games with multiple launchers.
- Improved reliability when loading additional game modules and title updates, with safer recovery after failed launches.
- Improved recognition of game files and preservation of launch preferences across library updates and shortcuts.
- More precise on-device Vulkan driver diagnostics, including the image check that failed and available error information.

Custom drivers remain device-dependent. More detailed diagnostics help investigate compatibility; they do not guarantee successful RADV loading or fix every game or mod.

Install over your current version; no uninstall is required. Keep a backup of your profiles and saves as usual.

releases.name: Cmod Progress Update - December 2025: What's next?
releases.body:
Hello!

It's been a little while, so I thought I would just give a small update on project status. 

- Winlator Cmod development continues!
- My focus on next release will either be mostly QoL. This means addressing long standing bug fixes, but more importantly, **merging and crediting improvements from other forks of Cmod from trusted developers.** Primarily I'll be focused on:
- Fixing dynamic package name paths for the gamepad implementation so that name can be changed, such as adding a ludashi benchmark version with the SDL joystick native controller support.
- Input control / touch screen control bindings bug fixes
- Minor UI improvements and enhancements
- Updating all drivers, Fex, Box64, and graphics Wrapper, following Pipetto-Crypto's advice when it comes to Streamlining and avoiding feature creep (...and avoiding pure AI code slop). 
- Improve ALSA-Reflector so audio stops cutting out after 15 minutes unless you switch to headphones.

releases.name: Winlator Cmod v13.1.1
releases.body:
_Minor update v13.1.1 fixed custom icons, default renderer, and warning prompt handling on new installs_ 

------------------------------

-   **`evshim` Rewrite:** The entire controller shim (`libevshim.so`) has been rewritten, **completely eliminating the use of shared memory (`mmap`)**, resulting in a massive reduction in CPU overhead and a significant performance boost, especially on lower-end devices. Box64 3.2 and 3.6 are now compatible, and have been restored.

-   **ALSA-Reflector Improved** The pacer's ring buffer and reconnection logic have been refined, expect better performance and reliability.

-   **Universal CPU Overhead Reduction:** I've gone through the code to find and eliminate performance bottlenecks, once again, big thanks to @Pipetto-crypto as always for the guidance and his improvements to the Graphics Wrapper. 

### ✨ New Feature: VkBasalt Integration

-   **Per-Shortcut Sharpening & Effects:** Thanks to @Pipetto-crypto You can now enable VkBasalt on a per-shortcut basis to apply CAS and DLS to your games.

### 🐞 Stability & Bug Fixes:

This update includes a huge number of fixes for a smoother experience.

releases.body:
Changes since the latest beta release:
- Fixed two UI issues (#843, #846)
- Fixed a bug in the CBM file system implementation (#853)
- Fixed a bug in the drive idle logic (#854)
- Fixed three drive-related VICE tests (#668, #674, #675)

Core and API

* Public API: The API now has as new shape. There are async counterparts (…Async) for state-changing calls, set is now setAsync, there is a new MemoryDebugger API, more getters, and suspend/resume coverage across the API.
* Threading: The command queue and message queue are now std::deque-based. Messages can carry exceptions. AudioPort is thread-safe. Cmd::CALL, TRACK_ON and TRACK_OFF are new.
* Messages: Msg::CONFIG is sent for every option change. ROM_LOADED, RSH_DONE and CONFIG_ERROR are new.
* RetroShell: It has the new architecture from vAmiga, with multiple shells and a single console per shell.
* Workspaces: A screenshot is now saved inside saveWorkspace().
* X-Ray: GPU X-Ray support is added, with a new XRAY_COMPOSITOR option.
* Shared libraries: utlib and rvlib were merged with the versions shared with vAmiga and Silicium.
* Cleanup: Header, include and namespace cleanups, plus removal of orphaned files.

Fixes

* Drive::isIdle() is fixed (#854).

This maintenance release primarily addresses issue #851, which prevented the app from running on the upcoming macOS 27 Golden Gate. It also includes internal code changes required to make the core compatible with the architecture of the upcoming Silicium emulator.
Removing beta status, as no significant bugs have been reported for some time.

## Refactoring

This beta release introduces substantial changes to the underlying code base. As part of the development of the RetroVault app, a new **RetroVault** library has been created. This library is now responsible for managing:

- File systems  
- Devices  
- All supported image formats  

RetroVault is designed as a standalone library and is also used in the latest version of vAmiga for the same purpose.

In addition, the new **utlib** library has been introduced. All utility functions previously embedded in vAmiga and VirtualC64 have been refactored into this more powerful shared library. This makes it easier for me to share common functionality among the different emulators. 

## Enhancements

- The disassembler now supports symbol files (#837)

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed a crash in the file system importer when importing excessively large folders (#841)  
- Fixed a bug in the VIC inspector that prevented selecting individual sprites in Tahoe (#840)

releases.name: CapyPS5 v0.1.0 (beta)
releases.body:
CapyPS5 0.1.0 is the **first beta**: faster on every game, fewer crashes, and on-screen controls you can lay out yourself. PS4 backward compatibility stays experimental. Existing installs are offered this update in the app.

**Faster**
- **The GPU thread runs on the fastest CPU cores.** On a Snapdragon 8 Elite this alone made a demanding Unreal Engine 4 level about a third faster.
- **Less waiting for the GPU.** Several cases where the emulator stopped to read back data the GPU had just written are gone:
  - fast-clear metadata fills now run on the CPU;
  - GPU-driven draws of PS4 games are executed on the GPU;
  - fresh buffer data is copied without a system call per page.
  The same level gained about 30 % more on top.
- **Cheaper per-draw work:** shader resource tables are read in one go per table on ARM, which halved the cost of preparing each draw.

**More stable**
- Unreal Engine games that closed with a corrupt memory error a few seconds into a level (the game's own allocator reporting a broken "canary", or a crash reading address 1) no longer do: the emulator stopped waiting for a GPU signal that was only late.

releases.name: CapyPS5 v0.0.6
releases.body:
Sixth alpha of the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android, and the first with **PS4 backward compatibility**: PS4 games now run in CapyPS5 the way they do on a real PS5. Existing installs are offered this update in the app.

**New: PS4 backward compatibility**

A PS5 runs PS4 games on its own hardware. CapyPS5 does the same in software: PS4 games use the same x86-64 JIT, system libraries and Vulkan renderer as PS5 games, and only what the PS4 does differently was added.
- **GPU:** PS4 (GCN gfx7) shaders and registers, PS4 render targets and texture tiling, CMASK and HTile fast clears, cube and volume textures, and the PS4 Gnm driver calls.
- **System:** PS4 executables and the modules games ship, the PS4 memory layout and flexible memory budget, and PS4 save data and trophies.
- PS4 games go in the same game folders as PS5 games (a folder with `eboot.bin` and `sce_sys/param.sfo`) and carry a **PS4** mark in the library.
- This is the first release with it. 2D and Unity games run best; Unreal Engine 4 games start but are slow; many games don't boot yet. Lower the resolution for big games.

**Also new**

releases.name: CapyPS5 v0.0.5
releases.body:
Fifth alpha of the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android. Mali GPUs on their system driver can now run games, and the FPS counter shows how many frames CapyPS5 Framegen adds. Existing installs are offered this update in the app.

**New**
- **Mali on the system driver:** that driver cannot sample BCn compressed textures, so the GPU used to be rejected. CapyPS5 now decompresses those textures on the GPU when it uploads them (BC1 to BC7, including BC6H HDR textures). GPUs that support BCn keep using it directly.
- **PanVK on Mali:** the GPU is no longer rejected when the driver lacks vertex-stage stores or dual-source blending.
- **Framegen counter:** with CapyPS5 Framegen on, the FPS counter reads *XX FPS - YY FG*: XX are the game's own frames, YY the total including generated ones. The options are now called *Framegen x2*, *x3* and *x4*.
- **HDR10 output:** games that output HDR10 are converted to SDR for the screen.

**Fixed**
- Tessellation: quad domains, fractional-even spacing, counterclockwise output and masked hull control points.

releases.name: CapyPS5 v0.0.4
releases.body:
Fourth alpha of the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android. More than 100 games now run correctly according to testers' reports, and this release adds CapyPS5 Framegen. Existing installs are offered this update in the app.

**New**
- **CapyPS5 Framegen:** optional frame generation. It draws in-between frames from the motion between two game frames, so a game at 30 FPS is shown at 60. Off by default; turn it on in *Settings → Performance* (1 per frame, or up to 3). Adds one frame of latency and some GPU load; works best from 25 FPS up.
- New performance options in *Settings → Performance*: shadow resolution, early depth testing and a frame rate limit (30 or 20 FPS).
- Physical keyboard input and an on-screen keyboard toggle for text fields, and system dialogs that can now be answered.
- Android 16 and devices with 16 KB memory pages are supported.

**Fixed**
- Unreal Engine 5 games: graphics and async compute hand work back and forth several times per frame, and each hand-off waited up to 100 ms. Menus that ran at 0–2 FPS now move.
- Games whose shadows use depth-compare texture gathers (Castlevania: Belmont's Curse) closed after the menu.

releases.name: CapyPS5 v0.0.3
releases.body:
Third alpha of the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android. Fixes for the logs testers sent on v0.0.2, CPU work for Unreal Engine games, and more from KytyPS5. Existing installs are offered this update in the app.

**Fixed**
- Games that use fibers (sceFiber) closed the emulator at start on ARM ("Fiber context switching is only implemented on x86_64", Toy Story Retro Roundup). Fibers now switch the game's own registers. First support: please report how fiber games behave.
- Final Fantasy VII Rebirth: sceKernelFtruncate, which it calls when saving, is now available.
- Mewgenics: pthread_setcanceltype is now available.
- The game clock (RDTSC) ran about 23 % faster than the frequency games are told; they now match.
- Very large GPU compute dispatches (over 65535 groups, as in Astro Bot) are split to fit Adreno limits.
- Unity backtraces no longer follow a bogus frame at the start of each guest thread.

**New**
- Unreal Engine games: the TLS and process clock reads they make millions of times a second run inside the game code instead of calling into the emulator.
- Shaders can read the real GPU clock (S_MEMREALTIME) on drivers that offer it.

releases.name: MAME4droid 2026(0.289) 1.40.6
releases.body:
## Added NetPlay Public Rooms

Until now, NetPlay worked over the internet with no account, no relay, and no service to trust. The one thing it could not do was find you an opponent: you still had to know someone already, and swap an IP address with them by hand.

**Public Rooms** is that missing half. It's an optional board where hosts advertise the game they are hosting, so anyone with the same ROM can tap it and connect.

What it is *not* is a relay. The board introduces two players and then steps out of the way — the match still runs directly between the two devices, exactly as it did before, and nothing about it passes through any server of mine. 

### On the board

* **Room codes.** Every room gets a short code you can pass to a friend. 
* **PIN rooms.** Tick *Require PIN* and the room still appears, marked as protected, but only the people you told can get in. The PIN itself never reaches the server — only a hash of it does.
* **A color-coded connection forecast.** Green, amber, or red per room, based on what STUN actually measured about both routers rather than a guess. Two symmetric NATs with no way through show red and refuse the join.

## 1.37 NetPlay

This release introduces **NetPlay**: play the same game together over Wi-Fi or the internet, built from scratch as a native part of MAME4droid rather than bolted on.

### Two sync modes:
- **Rollback** — save-state resimulation for near-zero input lag, ideal for fighting games and fast action titles. Boot is fully deterministic (RTC, samplerate, disk/NVRAM state pinned), so only inputs ever cross the network — nothing bulky to transfer at connect time.
- **Lockstep** — simple guaranteed sync for titles where rollback doesn't apply cleanly.

releases.body:
**Console Five Pro v0.0.9proQ4** — an independent rebranded build of CapyPS5 v0.0.3, the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android (built on KytyPS5 and the FEX x86-64 JIT).

## v0.0.9proQ4 — the freeze fix, the after-freeze crash, frame flow in heavy 3D (same graphics)
- **Fixed: the multi-second freezes.** A draw whose pipeline was still compiling used to block the renderer with an *unbounded* wait on the compile queue. A storm of first-visit pipelines (a new area, material streaming, one-shot LUT passes) could then park the whole renderer behind the workers for tens of seconds - the field logs show 14-28 s of frozen video and starved audio right before the session died. No draw waits more than `debug.capy.pipeline_wait_ms` (default 4 ms, 0 = never wait) now: past the bound the draw is skipped, the compile lands in the background, and the next occurrence draws for real. Every pipeline miss is queued to the async workers - the renderer never compiles inline during play.

openMSX 21.0 has many improvements on the new GUI introduced in openMSX 20.0 (especially the debugger) and several other smaller features. releases.body:
Fifth beta of the Android port of the PS5 version of **Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted** (AnyPS5 + Box64 + Turnip). Installs over earlier betas, game data and settings are kept.

> ⚠️ The game is not included — you need your own legally obtained, **decrypted** PS5 dump (PPSA29802).

### Fixes
- **A second player (2P) joined when pausing.** The game opens a second ("special") pad port, and it got the same input as the real pad, so Options there counted as player 2 joining. Only the standard port is the pad now.
- **Touches beside the on-screen buttons acted as a mouse**, a second input device for the game. The touch controls are the only player-1 input now (a real mouse or keyboard still works once used).

### Performance and heat
- **Built-in Turnip updated to Mesa 26.3** with our patch for importing the game's memory directly (no per-draw copies). If you picked another driver in *Settings → GPU driver*, switch back to **Built-in**: drivers without this import copy memory on every draw.

releases.body:
Fourth beta of the Android port of the PS5 version of **Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted** (AnyPS5 + Box64 + Turnip). Installs over earlier betas, game data and settings are kept.

### Fixes
- **Missing graphics and crashes on scene changes** (starting a level, the money bag at the end of a level): results the GPU writes back into game memory were silently skipped on pages the driver's write tracking had protected, so the game read stale or zero data. Source revision: `e750c469bed4a87644a1dac43ff7e1a137d32120` (version code 4, version name `0.2.1-stable+e750c46`).

### Fixes and improvements

**Counter-Strike 2**
- CS2 starts again on a fresh install. The game stopped with "A game file appears to be missing or corrupted" because its Panorama text library could not load next to the root filesystem's newer HarfBuzz. NgpCraft Emulator v3.9.0 - what's new
This release is about playing two players over the internet. It is still being tested, but the
first results are encouraging. If you play online, both of you should update, and please tell us
how it goes.

Online play in mirror mode should be smoother
Less input lag at the start of a match. The player who finished loading first used to start alone and wait for the other one. That wait made the emulator think the connection was slower than it really was, and it could add noticeable delay to that player's controls for several minutes. Both sides now start together. This idea comes from Blueteemo, who proposed it in pull request #26. Thank you!
Fewer freezes on a connection that loses packets. Your button presses are now also sent a second way, repeated several times, so a single lost packet should no longer freeze both screens. In our tests on a deliberately bad connection, most of the short freezes went away.
If the other player has an older version, the match should still work, just without these improvements.

# v1.2.1 — GEARMASS: нагрузка на все ядра; буфер команд («планировщик») из «me_1.2», доработанный

## GEARMASS — распределение нагрузки (`runtime/gearmass.c`)
Новая подсистема порта: решает, сколько потоков работает, как главные потоки ждут друг друга, на каких ядрах
они живут, сколько кадров CPU готовит вперёд и как поднимать качество, пока GPU свободен. **Никаких списков
телефонов и компьютеров**: всё выводится из топологии (число ядер, их частоты из `cpufreq`) и из замеров во время
игры.

Режимы (`ME1_GEARMASS`, лаунчеры → «Нагрузка (GEARMASS)» → «Режим нагрузки», `me1port.ini` `[Port] Gearmass`):

| | Эконом `eco` | Баланс `balance` | Производительность `perf` | Максимум `max` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Поток рендера `me1-d3d` (`ME1_D3D_CMD`) | 0 | 2 * | 2 * | 2 * |
| Рабочие потоки (`ME1_GM_WORKERS`) | 0 | до 2 | все свободные | все свободные |
| Кадров вперёд (`ME1_GM_AHEAD`) | 0 | 1 | 1 | 2 |
| Ожидание главных потоков (`ME1_GM_SPIN`) | сон | короткий спин | короткий спин | спин |
| Главные потоки на быстрых ядрах (`ME1_GM_PRIME`) | нет | нет | да | да |
| ADPF-цель / `uclamp.min` | — | — | 8 мс / 512 | 8 мс / 1024 |
| Лимит FPS | 30 | — | — | — |

## Что нового

### Linux — новая платформа
- Порт игры на Linux (x86-64 и aarch64): X11 и Wayland, рендеры OpenGL ES, Vulkan и Zink. Клавиатура, мышь с захватом
  (Ctrl+Alt+M — отпустить или захватить), геймпады с вибрацией и горячим подключением, звук.
- Свой лаунчер `me1-launcher`, повторяющий Android-версию: выбор папки игры, автоподбор настроек под видеокарту,
  графика, моды, DLC, переменные окружения, журнал запуска. До первого кадра игры показывается экран загрузки.
- Разумные значения по умолчанию: Vulkan на дискретной видеокарте, разрешение рабочего стола, без ограничения FPS,
  точная эмуляция float D3D9 (без чёрных и белых точек).
- Установка через `linux/install.sh` (ярлык, иконка, удаление через `--uninstall`).

### Сборка
- Два скрипта в корне исходников — `build-linux.sh` и `build-android.sh` (справка по `-h`).
- Сами находят игру (Steam, в том числе Flatpak и Snap, `~/Games`, `~/GOG Games`, папки Wine) или берут её из `--game`.
- Сами находят `msvcr80`, `msvcp80` и `d3dx9_31`: в папке игры, префиксах Proton и Wine, на разделе Windows или
  достают из установщиков `vcredist_x86.exe` и DirectX. Версии DLL проверяются, заглушки Wine отбрасываются.

releases.name: v0.10.76 — Less work per draw on the main thread
releases.body:
## Changes

- **Less CPU time spent drawing each race frame.** The game's main thread now finds textures and sets them up for drawing with much less work, so busy frames with many objects on screen are less likely to run late, especially on phones that slow down when they get hot. On the AYN Thor, drawing a race frame takes about 0.7 ms less (about a fifth less per object drawn). The picture is unchanged. For #176

## Validation

- **Drawing time on the AYN Thor** (frame timing on, the middle of a Dolphin Resort race): 2.8 ms of drawing a frame and 3.1 µs per object, against 3.4–3.7 ms and 4.0–4.1 µs in 0.10.75; texture work went from about 1.0 ms to 0.3 ms a frame.
- **The picture is unchanged on Windows:** the same Windows checks as 0.10.75 all passed (see below), and while PR #454 was tested, the new code drew the same 27 pictures bit for bit as 0.10.75 from the title screen up to the race (races themselves never repeat exactly, so they were compared by eye).
- **The rest, as in 0.10.75:**
  - **Windows x64 package:**
    - A whole Dolphin Resort race on Vulkan with the validation layer: no errors, full speed (1.000).

releases.name: v0.10.75 — Hourly update check, and AVATAR without a model
releases.body:
## Changes

- **The update check now runs at most once an hour,** instead of once a day, so a new version shows up in the launcher sooner. It still sends no personal data, and you can turn it off under **General › Updates**. For #365
- **Picking AVATAR without a VRM model no longer hangs.** Before, choosing AVATAR in the character ring when no model was set in the launcher stayed on Now Loading for ever. Now you race as an empty rider (the Avatar's gear and board), and for the first seconds of the loading screen a note says **NO AVATAR MODEL. CHOOSE ONE IN THE LAUNCHER**. If you already have a model, nothing changes.

releases.body:
## Changes

- **Move and resize the touch buttons (Android and iOS).** A new section, **Controls › Touch and tilt › Move and resize touch buttons**, shows the game's screen with the touch buttons on it. Drag a button to move it. Tap a button to choose it, then use the **Size** slider to make it bigger or smaller. **Reset this button** and **Reset all buttons** put things back.
- **A layout made on one screen still fits another.** Each button keeps its distance from the nearer side of the screen (or from the middle), so a layout you make on a wide phone still has your thumb buttons at the sides, and START in the middle, on a 16:9 tablet.
- The game uses your layout for drawing the buttons and for where they react to touches. In races, the floating stick area follows the stick to its side of the screen.

For #443

releases.name: v0.10.73 — Plain race loading screen fixes on wide screens
releases.body:
## Changes

These fixes are for the **General › Gameplay › Plain race loading screen** option (added in 0.10.71, off by default):

- **No more half-window picture on wide screens.** On a screen wider than 16:9 (for example a 20:9 phone, or Aspect Ratio Auto in a wide window), when Now Loading went away the screen turned into a black frame squeezed against the right side for about 12 seconds before the race. The touch buttons and the frame-rate counter moved with it. Now the screen stays full until the race begins, and nothing moves. The Now Loading sign itself keeps its shape in the corner.
- **The hidden practice is now silent.** Before, you could still hear Omochao and the practice's sounds behind the black screen. The race's own sounds play as usual.
- **Buttons pressed during the screen no longer change the race start.** The hidden practice used to react to your controller, keyboard, touch buttons or tilt. Pressing buttons could start the race a little earlier than usual. Now your input is ignored until the race begins, so the race starts at the same moment however much you press.

Nothing changes when the option is off.

For #365

## Validation

releases.name: v0.10.72 — Round touch buttons on wide phones, and per-button touch options
releases.body:
## Changes

- **Touch buttons stay round on wide phones.** With **Graphics › Aspect Ratio › Auto** on a wide phone (19.5:9 or 20:9, for example a Galaxy A55), and on iPhones, which use Auto by default, the touch buttons were stretched into ovals, and the places you had to touch were stretched the same way. They are now round at any screen shape, the same size as before, and keep their distance from the screen edges, so each thumb's buttons stay where the thumb is. What you touch now matches what you see. At 16:9 (the Android default, and 16:9 devices such as the AYN Thor) nothing changes.
- **New: Customise touch buttons.** Under **Controls › Touch and tilt › Customise touch buttons** there is a row for each touch control (LS, RS, A, B, X, Y, LB, RB, LT, RT, START) with two switches:
  - **Shown**: turn it off to remove the control completely. That part of the screen then works as empty screen. For example, hide the left stick (LS) when you steer by tilting.
  - **Name**: turn it off to keep the button but hide its letters.
  - The existing **Button names** switch still hides every name at once. Everything is shown and named by default, so nothing changes until you choose.

releases.name: Nixport v1.2.304-alpha
releases.body:
**Nixport v1.2.304-alpha** — a test build for people who want to try it early.

> Published by hand: built and signed with the same key as v1.1.299-alpha and
> v1.0.267-alpha (upgrades install over them without uninstalling).

## Changelog (since v1.1.299-alpha)

### Gamepads

- **Single-player pad model** (replaces v1.1's player slots): exactly one physical
  pad feeds the game at a time. The pad you touch takes over automatically
  (last-active wins); the session drawer offers "use this pad" to pin a choice for
  the session. The effective pad and the on-screen controls merge into one player.
- **Fix: intermittent directional input**. After opening a menu or losing focus,
  sticks / D-pad / triggers now reach the game immediately at their current position —
  no more "only X works in the load screen" or "the first press does nothing".
  The old "stay blocked until centered" gate is gone (keys only).
- Rumble now always lands on the effective pad (Xbox-protocol pads don't expose
  motors to Android — enable "phone vibration" as the fallback).
- On-screen stale-state fix: a closed overlay can no longer pin the virtual stick
  over the physical one.

- **Player slots**: Player 1 = on-screen controls + one selected physical pad, merged.

  set one as Player 1, assign pads to Players 2-4, or unassign them. An explicit choice is

- **Rumble return path**: a game's rumble request travels back over NXP2 v3 and drives the
  pad's own motors (falls back to the phone's motor when the pad has none).

Marchwind64 的可选 HD 图片包，版本 HD 1.3，macOS、Windows、Linux、安卓通用（Switch 用下表里单独的一份），配 Marchwind64 0.5.3 或更新的应用使用。HD 包有自己的版本号，内容变了才发新版；有新版时游戏的更新检查会提示。

| 文件 | 大小 |
| --- | --- |
| `Marchwind64-HD-1.3.zip` | 629 MB |
| `Marchwind64-HD-1.3-switch.zip` | 1519 MB |

## 本版更新（HD 1.3）

### 战斗演出整体 HD

HD 1.2 的战斗里只有 cut-in 和道具是 HD 的。这一版把战斗动画里其余的画面基本补齐，从约 740 张增加到约 6900 张，都用本地放大模型从原版像素图放大，形状和配色跟原版走，在屏幕上的大小也和原版一样：

- **武器特效**：拳脚、刀剑、飞弹、炮弹、火焰等武器本身的画面。
- **光束**：外形逐帧严格照原版，只把内部改成第二次机器人大战 Z 的画法：白色的实心芯，外面一圈由浅到饱和的窄边。光束步枪、Mega 粒子炮、浮游炮、加特林光弹、扭转激光、闪电等共 99 组；原版渐隐的帧保持原来的暗度。
- **招式的后续画面**：命中之后的连续画面和残影，包括玫瑰高达的玫瑰浮游炮在各个转向角度的样子。
- **命中特效**与**击坠爆炸**。
- **防御**：盾牌、护罩等防御特效和被击中时的反应画面。
- **地图上的合体与变形动画**。
- **必杀技**：画面上的毛笔字，以及背后滚动的气场和星云背景。
- **着地阴影**换成柔边的圆形，大小不超过原版。

### 机体立绘

- 修了 26 张有乱纹的立绘，其中钢加农、神高达H、重装高达改、汉布拉比、马拉赛、巴乌、GP03S雄蕊 整张重画。
- 东方不败整张重画。
- 断空我的身体重画，两种站姿都换了。
- 大铁人补上原来没有的画面：两张立绘，宇宙和月面上穿宇航服的驾驶员，火箭飞弹、火箭筒这两招带驾驶员的帧，以及状态页不带驾驶员的那张。
- 新画的图都压回原版的亮度，和其他立绘放在一起不会显得特别亮。

### 地图机体图标

- 去掉敌方和第三方图标的红、黄描边。0.5.3 起我方朝左、敌方朝右，敌我一眼就能分清。
- 行动完的图标从 85% 灰改成 60% 灰，白色、灰色的机体行动后也能看出变化。
- GP03石斛兰和卡碧尼在行动前调亮，GP03 的蓝边加深。
- 大铁人的图标照原版去掉驾驶员。
- 断空我的图标换成新画的头部。

### 其他

- 剧情世界地图的地名牌多了韩文版，给韩文用。
- 没变的：人物头像、场间背景、剧情世界地图和战术地图的底图。

releases.name: Let's Go Launcher 0.2
releases.body:
# Let's Go Launcher 0.2

This is the second release of Let's Go Launcher. More modifications are coming — this is just the beginning.

## What it is

Let's Go Launcher is an Android port of Pokémon Let's Go Eevee, based on letsgo-recomp. It runs the game natively on Android and includes:

- Its own NSP importer — import the game from your own NSP dump. The import runs as a foreground service, and if an import is interrupted, the data file is verified and rebuilt automatically.
- Data pack import — import a ready-made data pack (zip) instead of an NSP.
- Turnip drivers — install and try community Turnip Vulkan drivers, with automatic rollback if a driver fails.
- Touch controls and physical controllers — play with the on-screen controls or a connected gamepad.

## What's new in 0.2

- **Mali support** — the game now runs on Mali GPUs (Galaxy S20+ and other Exynos devices). The Vulkan runtime falls back to render passes when dynamic rendering is unavailable, uses EXT dynamic state, and decodes BC7/BC6H textures on the CPU when the GPU can't sample them. Characters and the world now render with full textures on Mali.

releases.name: The Sims 2 for Android 0.2.1-dev
releases.body:
## What's new since 0.2-dev

- **Vulkan textures.** DXT1, DXT3, and DXT5 now use the correct BC formats on drivers that support them. This fixes colored noise on terrain, roads, and trees seen on Adreno 735 with both the system Vulkan driver and Turnip.
- **OpenGL ES.** Fixed dynamic buffer updates that could corrupt neighborhood chooser panels and text on Adreno 650 and 735, and the neighborhood HUD on Adreno 650.
- **Vulkan UI scaling.** The APK now includes precompiled SPIR-V variants for FSR 1 UI scaling for all 81 pixel shader entries and the built-in fixed-function pixel shader. Shaders outside the library, including shaders used by some mods, can still be compiled on the device.
- **Shader coverage.** The bundled library grew from 194 to 380 captured shaders and from 215 to 408 entries, including sampler variants. The updated capture tool checks bytecode hashes and records sampler variants. A strict diagnostic mode and a library format check help verify coverage.

## Install or update

Download the APK below or check for updates in the launcher. This build supports ARM64 devices running Android 10 or later and requires compatible The Sims 2 Legacy Collection game files.

releases.name: The Sims 2 for Android 0.1.2-dev
releases.body:
Development release for the Android ARM64 port of The Sims 2 Legacy Collection. The supported PC source is Steam build 18015495. See the [build and installation guide](https://github.com/phys-winner/pc_decomp_ts2/blob/f2b7cce5/readme.md) for requirements and instructions.

### Graphics and diagnostics

- OpenGL ES is now the default renderer. An explicitly selected renderer takes priority when it is available.
- Added DXVK with Mesa PanVK for compatible ARM Mali and Immortalis GPUs. The launcher checks the active driver and its Vulkan 1.3 capabilities, and supports importing a custom PanVK driver. The bundled kbase driver requires 4 KiB kernel pages. On Redmi Note 8 Pro (begonia) and TB373FU, PanVK uses linear buffers to address frame corruption.
- Added a live FPS counter and frame-time graph across renderers. The extended view shows system, GPU, memory, battery, thermal, and display information where Android makes it available.
- Improved Android surface handling in OpenGL ES and DXVK, including EGL recovery after a failed window bind. Added validation for shader bytecode, D3DX constant tables, GLSL generation, and texture dimensions and row pitches.

## What's new

- **Object selection:** A tap in Live Mode searches around your finger. A single object opens its actions directly. When several targets are available, a scrollable, game-styled picker draws a line to the center of each object and puts Ground last. releases.name: The Sims 2 for Android 0.1-dev
releases.body:
Initial public development release of **The Sims 2 Legacy Collection for ARM64 Android** through static recompilation of the original PC executable.

## Compatibility

Requires your own installation of **The Sims 2 Legacy Collection, Steam build 18015495** ([Patch Notes #8, 10 April 2025](https://steamdb.info/patchnotes/18015495/)). Other executable revisions, older disc releases, Ultimate Collection and mods have not been verified. The original PC game installation is not included in the download.

## Features

- Native ARM64 Android build with a Win32 compatibility runtime.
- OpenGL ES rendering and optional DXVK on supported system Vulkan drivers or the bundled Turnip driver.
- Touch camera gestures, Buy/Build drag placement, interface scrolling, gamepad input and an in-game cheat console.
- Adaptive interface enabled by default, with a checkbox in the launcher and in-game port settings.
- Automatic game language selection from the system locale, with manual overrides and 21 language choices.
- Direct play from a ZIP stored without compression. The archive remains read-only; writable files and converted textures are stored separately.

releases.name: Somniel v0.1.7a
releases.body:
## Somniel v0.1.7a

**A small update: a way to save a log of what went wrong, so crashes and loading-screen hangs can be tracked down.**

### New
- **Save diagnostic log.** A new row in the sidebar's main page saves the game's log to `Downloads/somniel_logs` in one
  tap. Do this before closing the game if it is stuck or misbehaving.
- **Asks to save the log after a crash or freeze.** When the game is opened again after it crashed or stopped
  responding (not after you simply swiped it away), it asks whether to save the log of that run to the same folder.
  Choose *Save log*; nothing is sent anywhere, the file just waits in your Downloads folder.
- The audio-failure log from v0.1.7 now goes to the same `somniel_logs` folder (it used to be `Somniel_log`).

### Bug reports
From now on **every crash or hang report needs the saved log attached** (the `.txt` from `Downloads/somniel_logs`).
Without it there is usually no way to tell what happened on a GPU we cannot test.

### Download

releases.name: Somniel v0.1.7
releases.body:
## Somniel v0.1.7

**Save export, customisable on-screen controls, dynamic resolution, Skip intro, a redesigned sidebar, and a fix for
missing sound.**

### New
- **Export saves.** The sidebar's *Import / Export Saves...* (was *Import saves...*) can now also export: all your saves
  go into one `.zip` wherever you choose, and the game keeps running. The file is checked after it is written, and it
  imports again as it is.
- **Customisable on-screen controls** (sidebar, *On-screen controls*):
  - **Size** (50% to 150%) and **Opacity** (20% to 100%) sliders.
  - **Edit layout**: drag any control (left stick, D-pad, right stick, A/B/X/Y, Minus/Plus, ZL/L, R/ZR) to where it
    suits you, tap one and use *Smaller* / *Bigger* to resize just that one, *Reset* for one or all. Back finishes.
  - **Reset layout** puts every control back (size and opacity are kept). Layouts are saved on the device.
- **Dynamic resolution** (on by default, checkbox under the render scale): when frames keep missing your frame rate,
  the resolution steps down in 5% steps, at most 20% below the render scale you chose, and climbs back when there is
  room again. It never goes above your choice.

releases.body:
## Somniel v0.1.6

**Dynamic game speed, a redesigned on-screen gamepad, and better telemetry.**

### New
- **Dynamic game speed.** The game's speed now follows the frame rate you actually get, so walking, cursor and game time
  stay at normal speed when your device dips below the frame rate you chose. It scales down to a floor of 20 fps.
  Applies to the hub walk speed, world-map walking and all per-frame game logic.
- **Redesigned on-screen gamepad** (phones).

### Improved
- **Telemetry** (only if you opted in to Share anonymous data): hitch reports now include a coarse reason for each slow
  frame, and time spent in the background is no longer counted. Still no names, accounts, IPs, paths or saves.

### Upgrading
- Install over your existing copy (or use **Check for updates**). **Do not uninstall first**, or you lose your game
  data and saves.
- Same signing key as earlier versions, so it updates normally.

releases.name: Somniel v0.1.4
releases.body:
## Somniel v0.1.4

**A smoother Somniel on Mali GPUs, far fewer stutters, and a working anti-aliasing switch.**

### New
- **Hidden object culling** (Graphics page): skips objects that are completely hidden behind walls. On a Dimensity 7300 (Mali-G615 MC2) the
  Somniel shops went from about 25 fps to a steady 29–30 fps. **Auto** (the default)
  turns it on for Mali GPUs only, because it made a Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 (Adreno 740) slower in testing.

### Fixed
- **Stutters while walking around the Somniel.** Shaders the game had already prepared were being prepared again,
  causing pauses of up to half a second. Walking the Somniel Plaza now has no pause longer than about 50 ms.
  This is repaired automatically the first time you start v0.1.4.
- **Anti-aliasing Off now works in the Somniel.** Before, it only took effect on the battle map. Turning it off gives
  about 2 fps more in busy spots on Mali GPUs.

### Upgrading
- Install over your existing copy. **Do not uninstall first**, or you lose your game data and saves.
- Same signing key as earlier versions, so it updates normally.

### Download

## Eastward Custom v1.2.0

Rilis stabil besar dengan perbaikan **Force Close & Black Screen Helio G99**, perbaikan **glitch layar separuh Snapdragon 695**, **optimasi shader Post-FX & TBDR** agar jauh lebih ringan tanpa gambar burik, serta **tampilan launcher baru**, **pengaturan layar live (`16:9` / `Wide Full`)**, dan **penanda deteksi HP/GPU otomatis**.

* **Fix Force Close & Black Screen Helio G99 / MediaTek Mali (Android 14/15):**

  * Memperkuat dukungan driver kustom **PanVK / Panfrost Mali** (seperti **FristOneRR v3.70+** untuk Mali Valhall/Bifrost) dengan pengecekan `/dev/mali0` via `stat()` yang tahan pembatasan SELinux.

releases.body:
## Eastward Custom v1.1.9 (Eksperimen)

> Build ini ditandai sebagai **Pre-release (Eksperimen)** untuk pengujian komunitas (tetap bisa kembali ke rilis stabil `v1.1.8` jika ada kendala di HP tertentu).

### Eksperimen Optimasi Performa & FPS Lock (MediaTek Helio G80/G88/G99 & Snapdragon)
- **Bebas Lock 30 FPS saat berjalan (`DM_VK_MAILBOX=1`)**: Swapchain Android memprioritaskan `VK_PRESENT_MODE_MAILBOX_KHR` lalu `FIFO_RELAXED_KHR` (fallback `FIFO_KHR`) dan memisahkan `VkPresentTimesInfoGOOGLE` saat mode ini aktif, agar frame `17–32 ms` tidak langsung dipaksa turun ke `30 FPS` saat berjalan atau pindah area. Dapat di-toggle via **Bebas Lock 30fps (Eksperimen)**.
- **Wakeup Present Instan (`ALooper_wake`) & Skip Clear Penuh**: Thread present dibangunkan langsung saat frame siap (`mtl_present` -> `front_android_wake`) sehingga mengurangi jeda polling `ALooper_pollOnce(4)`, dan melewati clear swapchain saat gambar mengisi layar penuh.

releases.body:
## Eastward Custom v1.1.8 (Glitch Fix + Simplified Display & Pixel Quality Settings)

### Perbaikan Glitch Visual (1.1.7 dibatalkan / dihapus)
- **Glitch bintik merah di layar judul & kotak/segitiga hitam di karakter/musuh diperbaiki total**: penyebabnya di 1.1.7 adalah penandaan RelaxedPrecision (FP16) pada OpLoad dari Uniform & Input yang mengganggu kalkulasi alpha/kedalaman/bloom. releases.body:
# 1.0.79 更新说明

## 本次更新

- **纹理缓冲视图改为跨帧共享缓存**：同一份来宾数据在多帧之间复用同一个 Vulkan 缓冲视图，视图改为随其数据缓冲一同销毁，不再随每帧临时槽回收。
  荣耀平板实机同会话交错对照（兵工厂熔岩场景，60 帧窗口口径）：提交 CPU 每帧减少约 1.6 毫秒，同热态帧率提升约 2.5；机制证据为视图创建次数由每帧 869 次降到 63 次。
- **画面零改动**：本次只改变视图的复用方式，不改动着色器、分辨率、精度、特效、渲染顺序，也不合并任何绘制调用。
- 新增运行时开关 `texviewcache`，可在同一会话内对照新旧行为，便于自行复核。

## 安装与数据

安装 `FFRS-1.0.79-universal.apk`。已有用户覆盖安装即可，游戏数据继续放在内部存储的 `FFRS` 目录。
本 APK 只包含运行时与兼容层代码，**不含游戏数据包、ROMFS、固件或密钥**；游戏数据与 DLC 仍通过对应数据包安装，由应用自动识别存储卷。

## 验证范围

荣耀平板（Honor GT Pro）实机复测：帧率 38.8~40.9，提交 CPU 19.7~20.5 毫秒，GPU 每帧约 16 毫秒；`device lost / VK_ERROR / fatal` 计数为 0；熔岩场景画面取证（辉光、蒸汽柱、法阵、角色、小地图、任务文字、交互提示）齐全，特效与显示无回归。发布件与已验证的测试件引擎代码逐字节一致，仅去掉测试标签。

未闭合项：所有场景稳定 40 帧以上尚未达成——兵工厂战斗场景约 37.7 帧，第 1 章探索约 39 帧。缺口已定位到描述符的逐绑定解析阶段（每帧约 7.9 毫秒，其中 Vulkan 调用仅占约一成），后续继续跟进。掌机（RG477M）实机回归因设备未连接，本轮未执行。

## 构建与校验

构建源码 `fb9598f`，APK 大小 `3753030` 字节。

SHA256 `cac57659755ae40691ad010c146dfb008883b7f7d9b57bcb748c53487814f9de`。

releases.body:
# 共鸣1.0.63预览版更新说明

默认取消额外的宿主帧率限制，旧发行默认30/60设置在升级后迁移至不限帧，之后仍可使用已有显式限帧标记。沿用当前分辨率策略和游戏原有时间逻辑。最终帧率取决于具体场景、硬件和驱动，刷新率请求与实际游戏帧率分别记录。

本版按内存压力下优先保住游戏进程的方向改造。每半秒主动检测内存，压力升高时停止后续预热，释放可重建缓存，并在GPU完成使用后清理空闲资源。该过程可能带来短暂停顿或之后首次技能编译停顿。

回收后按实际RSS增长决定再次清理，减少常驻工作集被反复清空重建。系统持续低内存且回收收益很小时延长重试间隔，压力升级和明确系统通知继续处理。修正诊断日志写满后停止更新的问题，保留最近两个有界窗口及独立fatal记录。

输入基线为1.0.62，保留新旧数据及实际DLC识别机制。索尔1.0.62战斗人影闪烁继续单独追踪，当前候选尚未完成该场景显示验收。

## 安装

已有用户在游戏内保存并退出后，覆盖安装FFRS-1.0.63-preview-universal.apk即可。继续沿用现有游戏数据和存档。新用户按发布目录的安装说明放置FFRS-data.zip中的完整FFRS目录。

沿用62的新旧数据包识别机制，DLC按设备上的实际内容加载。此次数据包无需重新下载，本地发布目录的完整ZIP共40550项已全部通过CRC校验。

## 实测范围

解锁后的63已通过111项宿主检查和Android构建，RG477M实际启动确认target_fps=0，旧30帧标记已迁移。标题动画观察到约54至59次真实呈现/秒。第三章客栈6.13秒移动窗口267帧，实际约43.71FPS，最大间隔57.68ms。这些结果各自限定其场景。

源码ca59451的Android打包和111项宿主检查通过，653项源码输入前后摘要一致。RG477M安装回读通过，并使用隔离存档读档进入土之神殿。

解锁前构建首次主动回收释放约222MiB RSS。神殿场景注入强压力通知后释放约143.8MiB，之后仍能移动。该构建神殿8秒移动实测约19.06FPS。高负载场景的实际帧率仍待继续优化，系统仍可能在内存不足时终止应用。

水都室外走动及水面发光花朵附近的卡顿继续定位。故障原机低内存退出、索尔人物闪烁和小米长停顿仍待对应设备复测。蓝牙连续音频、热插拔与独立QA本轮未运行。

本次集中补齐部分高通设备的浮点纹理采样兼容路径，针对用户报告的开场火场最终 BOSS 后、紫色传送门剧情进入第二幕时退出的问题。新增用户诊断报告也记录了相同的 R32 过滤能力错误退出。相关设备的本版转场复测仍待用户反馈。

- 对缺少 R32_SFLOAT 线性过滤能力的设备，增加适用的浮点双线性插值路径，保留原 R32 数据精度。
- 按着色器实际用途处理 Fetch/Gather 采样器参数，补齐图像描述符缓存隔离，并将新变体接入预热和持久化缓存。

1. 在游戏内保存进度并退出。
2. 下载并覆盖安装 `FFRS-1.0.62-preview-universal.apk`。
3. 启动后读取已有存档，复测此前发生退出的位置。

旧、新数据用户共用此 APK。游戏内容版本与 DLC 由已导入的数据决定，升级数据请按相应数据包说明操作。

- Android ARM64 构建及 109 项宿主检查通过，647 份源码输入在构建前后 SHA256 一致。
- 真实故障相关着色器的绑定 52、106、118 改写及 SPIR-V 校验通过，生产变体选择通过 ASan/UBSan 回归。
- RG477M 上执行 500 组独立 Vulkan 采样对照，同时核对原硬件线性采样、生产改写结果及独立 CPU 参考计算，测试范围内两组 GPU 结果最大差为 0。
- APK 签名、完整 ZIP CRC 和本地交付文件摘要已核验。

6 项旧的可选真实着色器测试因缺少输入标记为 SKIPPED。本次相关真实采样模块测试已执行。

## Cutscenes and the title screen are sharp (the real fix)

Close-ups in the *Golden Playhouse* cutscenes (the ones with the black bars) could still come out blurred from edge to edge, faces included, and the title screen looked out of focus. v0.1.1 blamed a short block of shader constants; that was wrong: the depth-of-field pass never reads those bytes.

The real cause is the depth format. The game never tells the graphics API which depth range it uses, and the port assumed the OpenGL-style one, which stores depth squeezed into 0.5–1. The game's depth-of-field planes come straight from each cutscene's data and are written for a plain 0–1 depth, so a face in a close-up landed *behind* the focus plane and the whole frame got the maximum blur. When the game does not choose, the port now uses 0–1 depth, so close-ups keep the face sharp and blur only the background, as intended.

- Checked on the Flip 2: the title screen (same shot before/after: background, piano and characters go from blurred to sharp), the host's introduction, the opening credits, the opening nightmare cutscene and the first puzzle stage, at 30 fps.

releases.body:
## Cutscenes are no longer blurry

The story cutscenes presented as the *Golden Playhouse* broadcast (the ones with the black bars) came out as a uniform blur: faces were unreadable while the on-screen text stayed sharp the whole time.

The game's depth-of-field pass binds 28 bytes of shader constants but reads 32. On the console those last four bytes are the next bytes of the game's own structure; the port filled them with zeros, so the last parameter arrived as 0 and the blur map came out maxed over the whole image. Those bytes now come from the game's memory, which gives the pass its real value. `<data>/sin_ubo_detras` restores the old behaviour for testing.

- **TV mode measured on the Flip 2** for the first time: the game renders at 1080p instead of 720p + upscale and it holds **30.0–30.1 fps with the game GPU at 4–10 ms**. It makes text and edges noticeably sharper; it is a switch in the settings panel (swipe in from the right edge).
- Also checked with the fix: every scene that is *supposed* to be soft (the opening dream sequence, the title screen's shallow focus) is unchanged.

## First public release

A native Android port of the console version of **Catherine: Full Body** for the **Retroid Pocket 5** and the **Retroid Pocket Flip 2**, running from your own copy of the game.

- **Early.** Tested on the Flip 2 from the title screen through the opening and into the first puzzle stage: a locked 30 fps (no frame over 40 ms in six minutes of play), rendered at the game's 720p and upscaled to 1080p with AMD FSR 1, with the videos playing. It has not been played past the first stage, so later stages may still show problems.
- **30 fps** is the game's own rate: its logic advances once per frame, so it cannot be pushed to 60 without doubling the speed of the game.
- **Network question:** the game asks at start-up whether to connect to the network. Answer **No**; online modes are not available.
- **Setup screen.** The app asks for the folder with your extracted game files, checks them and starts the game. The ExeFS folder must be complete: besides `main` the game brings its own shader compiler in `subsdk0`, and the app loads it. Prepared with 1.0.0; other versions are accepted with a notice.
